summary: Backend testing for Calm & Chaos completed. All 18 tests passed against the public URL covering greeting, chat (all 4 modes + empty validation + recent/history/clear), braindump CRUD, training CRUD + template, patterns, and calendar (status/oauth_login/today unlinked). No _id leaks in any response.
critical_code_review_comments: patterns.py late-night filter uses ambiguous precedence: `a and b or c and d` in line 313 — works only because of operator precedence. Should be wrapped in parens for clarity: `(role==user and hour>=23) or (role==user and hour<5)`.
_recent_history replay loop (lines 207-213) replays only user messages without assistant turns, so LlmChat context is one-sided. Functional but may not provide intended conversation memory.

chat endpoint uses a single fixed SESSION_ID per mode for LlmChat — LlmChat may itself retain memory server-side; combined with manual replay this could double-feed history. Consider relying on a fresh session per call OR on LlmChat persistence, not both.
Mode validation missing: `ChatRequest.mode` accepts any string; invalid modes silently fall back to `send` prompt. Add Literal['send','hard_truth','ground_me','organize'] for stricter validation.
calendar_today returns 200 with `linked: false` even on API error (line 488-490) — masks real Google API failures from the frontend. Consider distinguishing 'not linked' vs 'error'.
No pagination/limit guard on /api/chat/history (hardcoded 500), /api/braindump (500). Fine for single-user app but worth a note.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed braindump and training entries and chat messages. Test class flow deletes the created entities; chat history is cleared at module start and at end of TestChat class via test_chat_clear.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully green. If retesting, run `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. OAuth callback flow not tested (requires real browser & Google login). Tests assume the public URL https://moss-grounded.preview.emergentagent.com is reachable.
